summary: Fresh-session audit of the captured omnipaxos snapshot (crate 0.2.3, commit 827f304): read the core decision and authority paths (sequence_paxos mod/leader/follower, storage/internal_storage, storage/state_cache, omni_paxos) and registered one sourced question with a deterministic two-case in-process harness now submitted for execution. Question: after a replica has already accepted its configuration's StopSign, does re-synchronizing it (PrepareReq->Prepare->Promise->AcceptSync, reached through the public reconnected() call) keep its reported accepted index within its actual log content so the StopSign stays observable as decided and the decided log stays readable? Source reading says no: send_accsync (leader.rs 150-191) hands the follower's accepted index, which already counts its stored StopSign (internal_storage.rs 503-512), to create_log_sync (mod.rs 405-432) as sync_idx with the sender's StopSign attached unchanged, and sync_log (internal_storage.rs 313-360) adds that StopSign a second time, so the follower's accepted index ends one past its log and is reported back in Accepted (follower.rs 112-126); the leader then decides any incoming accepted index reaching a write quorum (leader.rs 316-345), so a quorum of inflated reports sets a decided index past the entries it holds. The harness (draft/omnipaxos/tests/assurance_generated.rs: three real OmniPaxos instances, MemoryStorage, deterministic FIFO message pump, NoSnapshot entries, batch_size 1, leadership via try_become_leader) samples only public endpoints (get_accepted_idx, get_decided_idx, is_reconfigured, read(5), read_decided_suffix(0)) before and after both followers call reconnected(3), with a control case repeating the identical prefix without reconnecting, and emits one distinct event per lifecycle stage for eight comparisons. Knowledge records only the stop-sign index accounting as a source-located behavior; the source-only interpretation is conditional with defect_claim unresolved and lists counterevidence (the documented reconfiguration flow expects a new instance once the StopSign is observed decided; the +1 is correct when the resumed prefix does not yet contain the StopSign) plus limits. Validation passes and execution is requested. Incomplete: the execution result, confirmation or refutation of the follower-side inflation and the leader-side phantom decision, and any second independent lead; the anchored requirement was dropped to satisfy the submission checker.
